To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the topological open-string partition function transforms as the wavefunction under modular transformation.

we have shown that, in local CY manifolds, a certain topological open string sector can be interpreted as a wavefunction, and that we have derived the wavefunctions of certain 1/2BPS Wilson loops in N=6 Super Chern–Simons theory at strong coupling.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the topological open-string sector in the framework of matrix models.
the study of the topological open strings in the context of the topological string theory.
the topological open-string partition function in Calabi–Yaus, which is the generating function for the Gromov-Witten invariants of the open string sector.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the topological open and closed string partition functions are wavefunctions in the sense that they satisfy a Schrödinger equation with a Hamiltonian given by the Laplacian of the Calabi–Yan manifold.
the wavefunction of topological open strings is a generating function for vacuum expectation values (VEVs) of 1/4 BPS Wilson loops, in the large N limit.

the topological open and closed string wavefunctions can be derived in a uniform manner from the topological recursion, and they can be used to compute vacuum expectation values of supersymmetric Wilson loop operators in the ABJM model at strong coupling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the topological open and closed sectors are related by an integral transform, which we call the topological open/closed string duality.
, at least for 1/2-BPS operators in local Calabi-Yaus, the topological string wavefunction is a generating function of all the vacuum expectation values.
the topological open/closed string wavefunction is a modular function of the closed string modulus.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the topological open and closed string wavefunctions are the same, and that the open string wavefunction is given by the matrix model partition function.
the open topological string partition function is a wavefunction, and this property should have important consequences for the study of open topological strings and the open topological vertex.
topological open string theory can be formulated in a way that is manifestly modular invariant.
